aiTitle: Quote for the Van der Merwe Wedding

message.content: Pull up the Van der Merwe wedding file. I need to send them a revised quote before they book the deposit.

content.text: I have the Van der Merwe draft open. It’s currently set for the 'Essential' package at 45,000 ZAR. Do you want to keep that price or adjust it?

message.content: Keep the price, but add the second shooter hour. They asked for extra coverage for the cake cutting and first dance.

content.text: Adding one hour of second shooter coverage increases the total to 48,500 ZAR. I’ve updated the line item. Shall I regenerate the PDF?

message.content: Yes. Also, make sure the payment terms say '50% deposit due upon signing' clearly. Last time they missed that line.

content.text: Updated. The payment terms section now explicitly states '50% deposit due upon signing, balance due 14 days prior to the event.' The PDF is ready for download.

message.content: Good. Now, regarding the editing for the Nkosi food shoot last week. I need to export the high-res files.

content.text: The Nkosi shoot has 342 images. I can batch export them now. Do you want them in Adobe RGB or sRGB?

message.content: sRGB. They’re uploading to their website. And apply the preset I saved yesterday.

content.text: Exporting in sRGB with the 'Nkosi_Food_V2' preset. This will take about four minutes. Shall I email the WeTransfer link to Thabo once it’s done?

message.content: Yes, do that. And check my calendar. I have a gear maintenance slot tomorrow, right?

content.text: Yes, you have a 10 AM slot with Lens Doctor for the sensor cleaning on the Sony A7IV. It’s confirmed.

message.content: Perfect. Send the quote and the food files. I’ll handle the rest.
